_comment: Google Drive-based configuration for the Blender cloud renderer.

_drive_layout._note: Everything below lives inside ONE folder on your Google Drive, e.g. MyDrive/BlenderCloudRenderer

_structure.config.json: This file. Drive folder + name/URL of the .blend, output folder name, animation flags, frames, engine, version
_structure.blend_files/: Drop your .blend file(s) here (or reference by Drive ID / public link)
_structure.output/: Rendered images / animation frames land here

drive._folder_id_note: Optional: hardcode the folder ID to skip interactive selection. Leave blank to pick folder in Colab UI.

_source_options.drive_id: Download by file ID from blend.drive_id

render._use_gpu_note: Cycles only. Colab must supply an available GPU (T4 works, A100 recommended).

blender._version_note: See cell 02: a custom tar can be added by editing BLENDER_DOWNLOADS below the huge list.
